video.title: Who Should Replace Gareth Southgate? | Monday Vibes
video.description:
We're back following another Euros heartbreak for England, with Gareth Southgate's side falling short against a fantastic Spain team in Berlin. What are the main problems holding this England side back? And does someone new need to come in for them to be fixed?

We take a look at another game in which Harry Kane and Kyle Walker looked well below their best, with Bellingham, Saka and Shaw the standouts for the Three Lions. And with Lamine Yamal and Nico Williams combining for the opener, are Spain leading the way for a new era of international football? 

And finally, we discuss possible replacements for Gareth Southgate. Who would be more suited to the role out of Eddie Howe or Graham Potter? Could Mauricio Pochettino be an option? Or will the FA recruit from within, with under-21s boss Lee Carsley also up for consideration after winning last year's European Championship!
